messages:
ida: Quick heads-up — ran a KV prefetch + batcher tweak against the small-rps workload and saw a weird TTFT bump on short prompts this morning.
matt: ugh, thanks. can you paste the profile?
ida: perf-bot posted the job, link below. Main observation: TTFT up ~18% at p50 for <= 32-token outputs, but tail and throughput fine.
perf-bot: Profiling job finished: https://ci.internal/reports/1782501234 (kv-prefetch-batcher-experiment)
shen: what did we change exactly in the batcher? more aggressive grouping of short requests?
ida: yeah — we lowered the min-batch-delay to 1ms and enabled a tiny prefetch window that issues a KV cache lookup for likely continuations when request arrives.
raj: prefetch sounds like it could add blocking work on the critical path if it runs synchronously before kernel launch.
matt: can you share the flame graph snippet? interested in kernel switch vs prefetch cost.
ida: pasted snippet from the profile:
```
TTFT timeline (short output):
  - accept -> prefetch_kv_lookup: 0.6ms
  - queue_wait: 0.8ms
  - kernel_select + context_setup: 0.9ms
  - launch_kernel: 0.4ms
  - decode: 1.2ms
```
ida: The prefetch_kv_lookup is new and is showing up before kernel_select which is shifting attribution.
shen: Hmm. Our current instrumentation assigns kernel time to "decode" bucket only after launch, but anything pre-launch gets lumped into TTFT-other. That's probably why the p50 looks worse.
raj: So it's an attribution problem not necessarily a pure perf regression. But prefetch could still be doing synchronous GPU memcpy or page faults?
matt: perf-bot's heap log shows most prefetch ops are host->device async memcpy but pinned memory alloc happened in the prefetch function.
ida: exact log:
```
[1782501200.123] prefetch_kv_lookup start
alloc_pinned_buffer(8192)
cudaMemcpyAsync(dst, src_kv, 8k)
sync_on_stream(stream0)
[prefetch_kv_lookup end] duration=0.62ms
```
shen: sync_on_stream is the red flag. Why are we synchronizing the stream in prefetch? should be fire-and-forget and then the kernel can wait on the memcpy stream if needed.
matt: Agreed. Two separate fixes: 1) remove sync_on_stream in prefetch (make it async + event), 2) update instrumentation to attribute pre-launch memcpy and kernel selection time to a new "prep" bucket so TTFT vs decode is clearer.
raj: For dashboards, we should show per-route breakdown: prep vs kernel vs decode vs postprocess. Right now only decode and total are surfaced.
ida: propose new metric names: token.prep_ms, token.kernel_ms, token.decode_ms, token.post_ms. And token.ttft_ms equals sum of prep+kernel+decode+post.
shen: Also add a boolean tag on samples for kernel_switch (true if we switched kernel at runtime vs pinned kernel). If kernel_switch has overhead, we can quantify.
matt: Good idea. Kernel selection is expensive when model seqlen changes. Add kernel_switch_ms and kernel_select_reason tag.
ida: Quick experiment plan:
- Roll prefetch change to async (no sync) in a feature branch.
- Add temporary instrumentation that timestamps: prefetch_start, prefetch_end, kernel_select_start, kernel_launch, decode_start, decode_end.
- Run the small-rps and mixed-rps workloads, collect p50/p95 for each token.* metric.
- Compare runs and export flame graphs.
raj: Who owns the dashboard update? I can do a quick Looker tile and a Grafana panel once we land metric names.
shen: I can change prefetch to event-based and remove sync. Will open PR today.
matt: I'll add the instrumentation hooks. Keep them behind a flag (perf_instrumentation=kv-prefetch) so we don't spam prod.
ida: Note: add correlation id to samples so we can trace a token across prep->kernel->decode in the traces.
perf-bot: New task created: PERF-4489 "Async prefetch + token prep instrumentation" assigned to shen,matt — https://tracker.internal/PERF-4489
raj: timeline? this is high priority for the perf dashboard refresh and the upcoming benchmark demo.
shen: PR by EOD tomorrow for prefetch change.
matt: instrumentation PR by EOD day after.
ida: after both merged, we'll run AB tests and report back. If kernel_switch_ms looks expensive, we might add a cache of selected kernels per route to avoid repeated selection.
raj: :rocket: nice. Also add a small note in release notes about the new token.* metrics.
ida: sounds good. I'll draft the dashboard layout and share a mock later today.
matt: thanks all. ping me if you want me to run the perf harness.
ida: thanks :thumbsup:
perf-bot: Workflow note: new metric names reserved in metrics registry — please add to metrics-schema before release."
